== instructions
Mode: sshd+caddy - run the script once on vps.example.com as root. It is safe to run again.

1. Copy stm-setup-dev-web.sh to the server, e.g.:
   scp stm-setup-dev-web.sh <admin>@vps.example.com:
2. Run it:  sudo bash stm-setup-dev-web.sh
   It creates user "tunnel" (no shell), allows only PermitListen 0.0.0.0:8080 for it in /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ssh-tunnel-manager-tunnel.conf, sets ClientAliveInterval 15 / ClientAliveCountMax 3 so a dead session frees the port within ~45 s, checks sshd -t and reloads sshd.
   Your public key is added to ~tunnel/.ssh/authorized_keys restricted to permitlisten="0.0.0.0:8080".

Caddy: point DNS for app.example.com at the server and open ports 80/443. If Caddy is installed (/etc/caddy/Caddyfile) the script appends the site block below, validates and reloads it; otherwise it prints the block for you to add:

app.example.com {
	reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8080
}

Check after connecting the tunnel:  sudo ss -ltnp | grep ':8080 '
== script stm-setup-dev-web.sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# SSH Tunnel Manager - server setup for tunnel "Dev Web" (mode sshd+caddy).
# Run on vps.example.com as root: sudo bash stm-setup-dev-web.sh
# Safe to run again; entries are added once. Debian/Ubuntu/RHEL-like systems with OpenSSH >= 7.8.
set -euo pipefail

TUNNEL_USER='tunnel'
KEYWORD='PermitListen'
SPEC='0.0.0.0:8080'
AK_OPT='permitlisten="0.0.0.0:8080"'
PUBKEY='ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIBkYk4V5vQ0n3cX2l9hHq2l0bJm2yJ8Qm8r7tHqf1c2d'
DOMAIN='app.example.com'
UPSTREAM='127.0.0.1:8080'

MAIN=/etc/ssh/sshd_config
CONF="/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/ssh-tunnel-manager-$TUNNEL_USER.conf"
MARK=ssh-tunnel-manager

die() { echo "error: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || die "run as root: sudo bash $0"
[ "$TUNNEL_USER" != root ] || die "use a dedicated user for tunnels, not root"
SSHD=$(command -v sshd || echo /usr/sbin/sshd)
[ -x "$SSHD" ] || die "sshd not found"

# 1. Dedicated user. '*' = no password but not locked, so key logins work; set one with passwd for password auth.
if ! id "$TUNNEL_USER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd --create-home --shell "$(command -v nologin || echo /bin/false)" "$TUNNEL_USER"
  usermod -p '*' "$TUNNEL_USER"
  echo "created user $TUNNEL_USER"
fi

# 2. sshd drop-in: one Match block per user; allowed forwards accumulate across tunnels.
if ! grep -Eqi '^[[:space:]]*Include[[:space:]]+(/etc/ssh/)?sshd_config\.d/\*\.conf' "$MAIN"; then
  cp -p "$MAIN" "$MAIN.$MARK.bak"
  sed -i '1i Include /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/*.conf' "$MAIN"
  echo "added Include to $MAIN (backup: $MAIN.$MARK.bak)"
fi
mkdir -p /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d

current() {
  [ -f "$CONF" ] || return 0
  awk -v k="$1" 'tolower($1) == tolower(k) { for (i = 2; i <= NF; i++) if ($i != "none") print $i }' "$CONF"
}
merge() { printf '%s\n' "$@" | awk 'NF && !seen[$0]++' | sort | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//'; }

listen=$(current PermitListen)
open=$(current PermitOpen)
if [ "$KEYWORD" = PermitListen ]; then listen=$(merge "$listen" "$SPEC"); else open=$(merge "$open" "$SPEC"); fi
listen=$(merge "$listen"); open=$(merge "$open")
[ -n "$listen" ] || listen=none
[ -n "$open" ] || open=none

forwarding=yes
if [ "$open" = none ]; then forwarding=remote; fi
if [ "$listen" = none ]; then forwarding=local; fi
gateway=no
for l in $listen; do
  case "$l" in none | 127.* | localhost:* | \[::1\]:*) ;; *) gateway=clientspecified ;; esac
done

tmp=$(mktemp)
cat >"$tmp" <<EOF
# Managed by SSH Tunnel Manager setup scripts: forwards allowed for user $TUNNEL_USER.
Match User $TUNNEL_USER
    AllowTcpForwarding $forwarding
    PermitListen $listen
    PermitOpen $open
    GatewayPorts $gateway
    X11Forwarding no
    AllowAgentForwarding no
    PermitTTY no
    ClientAliveInterval 15
    ClientAliveCountMax 3
EOF
backup=""
if [ -f "$CONF" ]; then backup=$(mktemp); cp -p "$CONF" "$backup"; fi
install -m 644 "$tmp" "$CONF"
rm -f "$tmp"
if ! "$SSHD" -t; then
  if [ -n "$backup" ]; then mv "$backup" "$CONF"; else rm -f "$CONF"; fi
  die "sshd -t rejected the new config; previous state restored"
fi
[ -z "$backup" ] || rm -f "$backup"

# 3. authorized_keys entry limited to this tunnel's forward.
if [ -n "$PUBKEY" ]; then
  home=$(getent passwd "$TUNNEL_USER" | cut -d: -f6)
  group=$(id -gn "$TUNNEL_USER")
  install -d -m 700 -o "$TUNNEL_USER" -g "$group" "$home/.ssh"
  ak="$home/.ssh/authorized_keys"
  touch "$ak"
  body=$(printf '%s\n' "$PUBKEY" | awk '{ print $2 }')
  if ! grep -qF "$body" "$ak"; then
    printf 'restrict,port-forwarding,%s %s %s\n' "$AK_OPT" "$PUBKEY" "$MARK" >>"$ak"
  elif ! grep -F "$body" "$ak" | grep -q " $MARK\$"; then
    die "this key is already in $ak without the $MARK marker; use a separate key for tunnels"
  elif ! grep -F "$body" "$ak" | grep -qF "$AK_OPT"; then
    awk -v b="$body" -v o="$AK_OPT" 'index($0, b) { $0 = o "," $0 } { print }' "$ak" >"$ak.$MARK.tmp"
    cat "$ak.$MARK.tmp" >"$ak"
    rm -f "$ak.$MARK.tmp"
  fi
  chown "$TUNNEL_USER:$group" "$ak"
  chmod 600 "$ak"
fi

# 4. Caddy site block (sshd+caddy mode only).
if [ -n "$DOMAIN" ]; then
  CADDYFILE=/etc/caddy/Caddyfile
  if command -v caddy >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$CADDYFILE" ]; then
    if grep -qxF "$DOMAIN {" "$CADDYFILE"; then
      echo "Caddy: $DOMAIN already configured, left unchanged"
    else
      cp -p "$CADDYFILE" "$CADDYFILE.$MARK.bak"
      printf '\n%s {\n\treverse_proxy %s\n}\n' "$DOMAIN" "$UPSTREAM" >>"$CADDYFILE"
      if ! caddy validate --config "$CADDYFILE" --adapter caddyfile; then
        mv "$CADDYFILE.$MARK.bak" "$CADDYFILE"
        die "caddy validate failed; Caddyfile restored"
      fi
      systemctl reload caddy || echo "reload Caddy to apply: systemctl reload caddy"
    fi
  else
    echo "Caddy not found; add this site block to your Caddyfile:"
    printf '%s {\n\treverse_proxy %s\n}\n' "$DOMAIN" "$UPSTREAM"
  fi
fi

# 5. Apply.
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-active --quiet ssh; then
  systemctl reload ssh
elif command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-active --quiet sshd; then
  systemctl reload sshd
elif [ -f /run/sshd.pid ]; then
  kill -HUP "$(cat /run/sshd.pid)"
else
  echo "reload sshd to apply: systemctl reload ssh"
fi
echo "done: $TUNNEL_USER may forward $SPEC"
== caddyfile
app.example.com {
	reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:8080
}
